encode_vectors_with_qinco_model: encode input vectors using a QINCo model and save codes to an npy file
decode_codes_with_qinco_model: decode QINCo codes back to reconstructed vectors using a trained model
run_encode_cli: run the codec CLI to encode vectors from an npy file with a QINCo model
run_decode_cli: run the codec CLI to decode packed codes back to reconstructed vectors
review_encode_function: review the encode function that batches vectors through a QINCo model and tracks MSE
